name: workthreads
tagline_zh: 团队一周的编码会话，自动按项目织成工作线。谁开了新坑、谁还吊着、谁刚收尾，一眼看清，不用翻聊天记录。
tagline_en: Turn a week of coding sessions into per-project threads. See what shipped, what's open, what just started—no.
desc_en: SpecStory Workthreads - a weekly work-thread rollup across a team's repos from SpecStory coding histories (any agent - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and more). It groups the window's sessions into threads of work per project and labels each new / open / recently closed, so a lead sees what shipped, what is still an open loop, and what was just started. Use when someone asks "what happened th
why_zh: 它跨 Claude、Codex、Cursor 等任意 Agent 的历史，按项目自动聚类并标注状态。
why_en: Aggregates histories from any agent—Claude, Codex, Cursor—into project threads with status labels, saving hours of manual log.
